title: Earnings Per Share Calculations - ASC 260
learning_objectives: Apply treasury stock method for options
Apply if-converted method for convertible securities

overview.required_for: Public companies with common stock or potential common stock
overview.presentation: Basic EPS and Diluted EPS (both required if dilutive securities exist)

basic_eps.formula: Basic EPS = (Net Income - Preferred Dividends) / Weighted Average Common Shares Outstanding

adjustments: Subtract preferred dividends declared (if cumulative, subtract whether declared or not)
Subtract preferred dividends in arrears (for cumulative only)

denominator.calculation: Weighted average of common shares outstanding during period
denominator.weight_by_time: Shares outstanding × Fraction of year outstanding
denominator.stock_dividends_splits: Retroactively adjust for all periods presented (as if occurred at beginning of earliest period)

example.facts: Net income $200,000. Preferred dividends $20,000. Shares outstanding Jan 1: 100,000. Issued 20,000 shares on July 1.

diluted_eps.purpose: Show EPS as if all dilutive potential common shares were converted/exercised
diluted_eps.formula: Diluted EPS = (Net Income - Preferred Dividends + Adjustments) / (Weighted Average Shares + Dilutive Potential Shares)
diluted_eps.antidilution_test: Include potential shares ONLY if dilutive (i.e., reduce EPS). If antidilutive (increase EPS), exclude.

treasury_stock_method.applies_to: Stock options and warrants (if exercise price < average market price)
steps: 1. Assume options/warrants exercised at beginning of period (or grant date if later)
2. Assume proceeds from exercise used to repurchase shares at average market price
3. Net incremental shares = Shares issued - Shares repurchased
treasury_stock_method.formula: Incremental shares = Options × (1 - Exercise Price / Avg Market Price)
treasury_stock_method.alternative_formula: Incremental shares = (Options × (Avg Market Price - Exercise Price)) / Avg Market Price
treasury_stock_method.antidilution: If exercise price ≥ average market price, options are antidilutive (exclude from diluted EPS)

example.facts: 10,000 options, exercise price $40. Average market price $50.
example.no_numerator_adjustment: No change to numerator (options don't generate income)

steps: 1. Assume preferred converted at beginning of period (or issuance date if later)
2. Add back preferred dividends to numerator (no longer paid if converted)
3. Add shares that would be issued upon conversion to denominator

example.facts: 1,000 shares $100 par 6% cumulative convertible preferred, each converts to 5 common shares. Basic EPS $2.00.
example.dilution_test: $1.20 < $2.00 basic EPS → Dilutive, include in diluted EPS

steps: 1. Assume bonds converted at beginning of period (or issuance date if later)
2. Add back interest expense (net of tax) to numerator (no longer paid if converted)
3. Add shares that would be issued upon conversion to denominator

example.facts: $1,000,000 face value 5% convertible bonds, each $1,000 bond converts to 20 shares. Tax rate 30%. Basic EPS $3.00.
example.dilution_test: $1.75 < $3.00 basic EPS → Dilutive, include in diluted EPS

sequencing_multiple_dilutive_securities.principle: Test securities in order from most dilutive to least dilutive (lowest incremental EPS to highest)
process: 1. Calculate incremental EPS for each potential dilutive security
2. Rank from lowest to highest incremental EPS
3. Include securities one at a time, starting with most dilutive
4. Recalculate diluted EPS after each addition
5. If adding security increases EPS (antidilutive), stop - exclude that security and all remaining

example.facts: Basic EPS $4.00. Three potential dilutive securities:
example.order: Include in order: Options ($0.50), then Preferred ($2.00), then Bonds ($3.00)
example.step_1: Add options: Diluted EPS decreases (dilutive) - include
example.step_2: Add preferred: Diluted EPS decreases further (dilutive) - include
example.step_3: Add bonds: Diluted EPS still decreases (dilutive) - include all

stock_dividends_and_splits.treatment: Retroactively adjust ALL periods presented as if occurred at beginning of earliest period
stock_dividends_and_splits.rationale: Stock dividends/splits don't provide resources - just change number of shares
stock_dividends_and_splits.example: 2-for-1 stock split on Oct 1, Year 2. In Year 2 EPS calculation, treat as if split occurred Jan 1, Year 1 (adjust prior period EPS for comparability).

preferred_stock_considerations.cumulative: Subtract preferred dividends whether declared or not (including arrears)
preferred_stock_considerations.participating: Subtract additional participation beyond stated dividend if applicable

contingently_issuable_shares.definition: Shares issuable upon meeting certain conditions
contingently_issuable_shares.basic_eps: Include only if conditions met by end of period
contingently_issuable_shares.diluted_eps: Include if conditions would be met based on current circumstances (even if period not yet ended)
contingently_issuable_shares.example: Shares issuable if earnings exceed $1M. Current year earnings $1.2M. Include in both basic and diluted EPS.

presentation.income_statement: Present both basic and diluted EPS on face of income statement (per share amounts for income from continuing operations and net income)
presentation.simple_capital_structure: If no dilutive potential common stock, only present basic EPS
presentation.complex_capital_structure: If dilutive potential common stock exists, present both basic and diluted EPS

cpa_exam_strategies.basic_eps: Income available to common / Weighted average common shares. Don't forget to subtract preferred dividends.
cpa_exam_strategies.treasury_stock_method: Options: Add incremental shares = Options × (1 - Exercise Price/Avg Market Price). No numerator adjustment.
cpa_exam_strategies.if_converted: Convertible preferred: Add back dividends to numerator, add shares to denominator. Convertible bonds: Add back interest × (1-tax rate), add shares.
cpa_exam_strategies.antidilution: Include only if incremental EPS < basic EPS. If antidilutive (incremental > basic), exclude.
cpa_exam_strategies.most_tested: Basic EPS calculation with weighted average shares. Treasury stock method for options. If-converted for convertible bonds.
cpa_exam_strategies.common_mistakes: Forgetting tax effect on convertible bond interest. Not weighting shares by time outstanding. Including antidilutive securities.

key_points: Basic EPS = (NI - Preferred Dividends) / Weighted Average Common Shares
Diluted EPS assumes all dilutive potential common shares converted/exercised
Treasury stock method: Options/warrants, add incremental shares (assumes exercise and repurchase)
If-converted method: Convertible securities, add back interest/dividends (net of tax) and add shares
Test for dilution: Include only if incremental EPS < current EPS (antidilutive securities excluded)
Stock dividends/splits: Retroactively adjust all periods as if occurred at beginning of earliest period
Sequence multiple securities from most dilutive to least dilutive (lowest incremental EPS first)
